role: Declares, once, what the private implementation estate is. Every tool in tools/ honours this file instead of carrying its own inline ignore list.
rationale: Before this file existed, six tools walked the whole estate directory with no ignore list and only two carried a three-prefix inline constant. Nested git worktrees (59 GB) and a vendored quarantine tree (10,914 files) were therefore hashed, link-checked, and disposition-checked on every run, costing 2m41s and ~190,000 spurious errors.

not_estate.reason: Nested git worktrees are developer host state, not implementation content. Relocated to /home/heathledger/Documents/ioi/worktrees/ on 2026-07-25 with `git worktree move`; the pattern is retained so a future nested checkout is excluded rather than scanned.
Vendored third-party trees and untracked evidence captures. Relocated to /home/heathledger/Documents/ioi/quarantine/ on 2026-07-25; the pattern is retained as a boundary.

Ad hoc authoring scripts. Two of them were unconditional writers that overwrote work-item records and minted evidence with no flag guard, so they must never sit on the active reader path or in a routine lane.

link_check_excluded._archive/: Archived bodies are frozen historical evidence. Their links are checked for existence at archive time and never rewritten afterwards, because rewriting an archived body would falsify the record it preserves.
link_check_excluded.generated/: Regenerated deterministically; link integrity is a property of the generator, not of the artifact.

nonclaim: This boundary describes scanning scope only. Excluding a path from the estate makes no claim about that path's contents, correctness, or value.
